info.title: Queue OpenAPI for kling/v4/long-image
info.description: Kling Image V4 Long Image generates long-form visual designs for webpages and ecommerce from a text prompt. It supports optional reference, style and subject images, along with length and resolution controls.

x-fal-metadata.about: Generate one long ecommerce detail page or webpage design image.

image_urls.title: Image Urls

items.limit_description: Max file size: 30.0MB, Min width: 300px, Min height: 300px, Min aspect ratio: 0.40, Max aspect ratio: 2.50, Timeout: 20.0s

image_urls.description: Product reference images (1-3) for 'ecommerce', referenced as @Image1, @Image2, ... Not supported for 'webpage'.

prompt.title: Prompt
examples: Design a visual long image for a specialty coffee brand's official website, including the hero section, product showcase, roasting philosophy, store information, and footer.
prompt.description: Text prompt for the long image. Reference images as @Image1, @Image2, ...

style_image_url.title: Style Image Url

anyOf.limit_description: Max file size: 30.0MB, Min width: 300px, Min height: 300px, Min aspect ratio: 0.40, Max aspect ratio: 2.50, Timeout: 20.0s

style_image_url.description: Optional 'webpage' style reference: the design follows its visual and layout style. Referenced as @StyleImage. Not supported for 'ecommerce'.

subject_image_url.title: Subject Image Url

anyOf.limit_description: Max file size: 30.0MB, Min width: 300px, Min height: 300px, Min aspect ratio: 0.40, Max aspect ratio: 2.50, Timeout: 20.0s

subject_image_url.description: Optional 'webpage' subject reference: the design is built around the subject it shows. Referenced as @SubjectImage. Not supported for 'ecommerce'.

skill.description: 'ecommerce' designs a product detail page and requires 1-3 product images; 'webpage' designs a website.
skill.title: Skill

sync_mode.title: Sync Mode
sync_mode.description: If `True`, the media will be returned as a data URI.

length.description: Page length for 'ecommerce': short (~2-5 sections), medium (~6-10) or long (~11-18). Ignored for 'webpage'.
length.title: Length

file_name.title: File Name
file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.

file_size.title: File Size
file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.

content_type.title: Content Type
content_type.description: The mime type of the file.

width.title: Width
width.description: The width of the image in pixels.

url.title: Url
url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.

height.title: Height
height.description: The height of the image in pixels.

schema.description: Whether to include logs (`1`) in the response or not (`0`).

success.description: Whether the request was cancelled successfully.
